title: U-DIADS-Bib: a full and few-shot pixel-precise dataset for document layout analysis of ancient manuscripts
reasoning: The paper focuses on document layout analysis of ancient manuscripts, specifically Bibles. While the subject matter (Bibles) is religious, the paper's objective is a technical computer vision task (segmentation, layout analysis) of historical documents, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical content itself. It analyzes the physical and logical structure of the documents, not the texts' spiritual or ethical implications.
